q: Which Horizon ingestion constant pins the highest supported protocol version, and what is its value?
answer:
Horizon's protocol ceiling: MaxSupportedProtocolVersion = 28 (a uint32 constant defined in internal/ingest/main.go) (verified 2026-09-01 at master AND at scanned ref 82660510 — https://github.com/stellar/stellar-horizon/blob/master/internal/ingest/main.go). Horizon split out of the stellar/go monorepo; the monorepo's frozen copy still carries pre-split values, so cite THIS repo for current Horizon constants.

(A fuller mechanism walkthrough exists via sources.deepWikiUrl — an undated index that can LAG the dated fact above; where they disagree, the dated fact wins.)
